items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nobody performed there but Country-and- Western. Roy Acuff. Hank Williams.

ctx.x: Where I’m going with this is, were you performing at all as a kid in Badin?
No, no-no, no-no. Nothing in Badin. Nobody performed there but Country-and- Western. Roy Acuff. Hank Williams. People like that. They didn’t have no jazz.
No black bands were coming through.
